The dwelling-fire form excludes water damage from a burst washing-machine supply hose under **E-17**:

> “Water damage from the discharge, rupture, or burst of a plumbing supply line within the dwelling.” — *DP-0110 ed. 02-24, SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-17* (policy-docs__search_policy result #2).
